titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena
titles.engine_and_build:
id Tech 3, OpenGL only. CONFIRMED against the staged binaries (md5 re-run on /mnt/retro-share).
- The default shortcuts 'Play Quake III Arena.bat' and 'Play Team Arena.bat' (+set fs_game missionpack) run ioquake3.x86.exe ('ioq3 1.36 win_mingw-x86 Apr 12 2009', md5 12f99bc0f9ba416ee477a4f13de8feaa).
  - It links the staged SDL.dll, which is SDL 1.2.13: the bytes at 0x68141000 are 01 02 0d (md5 a828ce4eae3a55de4a29112067975abc).
  - Its only display-mode import is SDL.dll!SDL_SetVideoMode. It has no ChangeDisplaySettings/EnumDisplaySettings import and no such string, so it cannot resolve one dynamically either.
- The third shortcut, 'Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat', runs id's quake3.exe ('Q3 1.32c', md5 b5cf3dd55e045aac6096ff97379d0cab), which imports CDS/EDS.
- FLEETGL.BAT picks quake3.exe for the default shortcut only when system32\3dfxvgl.dll exists and FR_W<=800, FR_H<=600. No connected box qualifies: .123/.145/.195/.240 have no 3dfxv* in system32, and .124's FR_W is 1280.

.124: GL over Glide.

The deployed 'Play Quake III Arena.bat' (md5 3d45f45125fc7114075199d9a749f8ae) matches the share on all five boxes. A stale 'Play Quake III Arena (retail 1.32c).bat' (1000 B, 08-29) sits on .123/.145/.240. It has no launch.txt line, so it has no shortcut.

titles.refresh_control:
CONFIRMED by an independent whole-file re-check.

ioquake3 1.36: r_displayRefresh is DEAD.
- 0x4d6bc7: Cvar_Get('r_displayRefresh'@0x52cbb6, flags 0x20 CVAR_LATCH).
- 0x4d6c04: the result is stored in global 0x1d9f7c0, then Cvar_CheckRange 0..200 (0x43480000).
- A 4-byte search of the WHOLE file, every section, finds 0x1d9f7c0 exactly once: the operand of that store (0x4d6c05). The name string is referenced once.

The rate comes from SDL 1.2.13:
- SDL_desktop_mode = EnumDisplaySettings(NULL, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS) at 0x68137884, i.e. the LIVE mode at video init.
- The DX5 GL fullscreen path (0x681388be) and the DIB path (0x68134d40) are identical:
  - dmDisplayFrequency = the desktop rate with dmFields 0x5c0000 only when w<=desktop_w and h<=desktop_h (0x68138dd5); otherwise 0x1c0000.
  - If the CDS fails, clear 0x400000 and retry (0x68138935).
- SDL.dll's only environment strings are SDL_VIDEODRIVER, SDL_VIDEO_CENTERED/WINDOW_POS/ALLOW_SCREENSAVER/YUV_*, SDL_WINDOWID and the audio ones. There is no refresh lever. The live desktop rate is the only input.

Retail 1.32c honours r_displayRefresh:
- It is read at 0x459ee7 (global 0xc59ba0, +0x20). dmFields goes from 0x180000 to 0x580000, then CDS_FULLSCREEN.
- If the CDS fails: '...trying next higher resolution:' and the first EnumDisplaySettings entry with w>=, h>= and bpp>=15, at that entry's own rate (EDS 0x45a036/0x45a074).
- The ENUM_CURRENT read-back at 0x45a1a8 becomes 'MODE: ... hz:N'.

.124 adds a layer on top:
- MesaFX fxBestRefresh asks for the best listed rate: 12x '1280x960 max 85 Hz -> GR_REFRESH enum 7' for ioquake3. The 10x10 SDL GL-probe context asks enum 0.
- Our h5 Glide hwcInitVideo (minihwc.c:4675) REPLACES the app's rate with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.
  - hwcGetenv (9547) reads getenv, then HKCU, then HKLM at the regPath.
  - getRegPath (1371) picks SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide whenever that key exists. On .124 it is an AmigaMerlin leftover.
  - HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH = REG_SZ '75'. There is no HKCU key and no user or system environment variable (REGREAD 04:06).
  - The deployed Glide binary carries both strings.
- win_mode.c:297-352: IDirectDraw2_SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp,rate) only when DirectDraw enumerates that exact mode at that rate; otherwise, or on failure, rate 0.
  - vcr-kmd has no 320x200@75 row (vcr_modes.c:22,60), which is why the probe opens land at 85.

The staged autoexec.cfg execs the file last.

A THIRD writer exists on .124: scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py IdTech3.fleetres_cfg writes the same 9 lines with FR_HZ.

The rate is never on the command line. It is inert for ioquake3; only retail 1.32c uses it.

titles.gap:
- .124: -10 Hz (75 against 85). MEASURED. The cause is the leftover HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 that Glide applies to every open, not FRHZ (85 = the best at 1280x960).
- LCD boxes: none.
- Latent: ioquake3 can only inherit the live desktop rate. A game mode larger than a stranded live desktop, or whose best is above the desktop's rate, gets the desktop rate or the driver default.
  - The no-rate default is measured at 60 on ForceWare 71.89 (refreshlogic.h).
  - It is now also measured on vcr-kmd: quake2/glquake/hl CDS at 1280x960 with no rate landed on mode 159 1280x960x32@60 while the desktop was 1280x1024@85 (124-window run1/run2).
titles.fix:
- LCD boxes: no change.
- .124: in all three Q3 launchers, set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH per process, placed after FLEETRES/FLEETGL and before 'start'.
  - Use a single top-level line, never inside a ( ) block, where %FR_*% expands at parse time: if /i "%FR_UE1DEV%"=="GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice" if not "%FR_HZ%"=="0" set "FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ%"
  - The staged FLEETRES.EXE (bb180f3b, all 41 copies) prints FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv only when HKLM\Software\RetroAgent\GlideRender=1 AND 3dfx silicon is present. Today that is .124 only: .243 has no GlideRender value, and the others have no VEN_121A.
  - getenv beats the HKLM '75'. The V5 lane's own glidelab already relies on this precedence (glidelab.c:1040-1045).
  - It covers ioquake3->retroicd and retail->3dfxOGL.
  - Rate: interim %FR_HZ% (85). Use %FR_HZW% once the gr_target_hz tokens land.
  - Generate the line from stage-fleetres.py (FLEETGL.BAT is share-only), not by a share-only edit.
- IN THE SAME CHANGE, update scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py so it keeps mirroring the shortcut. Give the IdTech3 class an env_lines() carrying the same FX_GLIDE_REFRESH; only GoldSrc has one today.
- Do NOT use 3dfxctl 'Auto' or edit HKLM/HKCU: that is a 3dfx setting on the V5 lane's box and needs an explicit chat decision. Removing the key would also drop 3dfxOGL and Glide-native apps that ask for 60 down to 60.
- Retail r_displayRefresh line: when the tokens land, flip %FR_HZ% to %FR_HZW% and gr_cfg_body(NULL)'s %FRHZ% to %HZW% in ONE release.
  - gr_cfg_body(NULL) is ALSO JediAcademy's body, so the two JA launchers (discmount specs) and lan_check's IdTech3/JediAcademyMP writers must flip in the same release.
  - The numbers are identical today on every box (60/60 on the LCDs, 85/85 on .124).
- ioquake3: no per-title lever. Keep GAMERES' desktop raise.
titles.fix_risk:
- .124 is the V5 benchmark lane's box; change it only with that lane's OK. CRT pacing: one launch at a time, 5 s or more apart.
- CORRECTION to the survey: lan_check.py does NOT run the desktop shortcut. It writes its own LANCHECK.BAT (the exe plus the launcher's arguments plus env_lines()) and its own fleetres.cfg. So its 'Quake III ioquake3 1280x960x32' row would STAY at 75 after the launcher fix, silently diverging from the shortcut it exists to mirror, unless it gains the same env line. V56KBENCH.BAT stays at 75 either way.
- The environment variable outranks the V5 lane's own 3dfx Control Panel refresh control (HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH). A rate the operator sets there would become a no-op for these shortcuts; agree that with the lane.
- 85 must be listed at every Glide open in the process: 320x200 (SDL probe) and 1280x960. vcr_modes.c:60 and :43 have both, and GAMERES lists both. An unlisted value cannot reach the tube: Glide falls back to rate 0 (win_mode.c).
- The interim %FR_HZ% follows the persisted 1280x1024 rate. A desktop left at 60 would pin Glide to 60, worse than today. %FR_HZW% removes that risk.
- Guard-test gap: test_gameres_mirror.py::test_a_shared_cfg_is_written_identically_by_both_writers concatenates EVERY .bat in the title directory. One launcher flipped to %FR_HZW% passes it while the others still write %FR_HZ%, and lan_check.py is not covered at all. Make it per-launcher before any token flip.
- Latent, pre-existing and not triggered on any connected box (persisted rates 60/85/75): FLEETRES FR_HZ takes the persisted rate in 50..240, else the live rate, else 60 (fleetres.c:882). gameres fr_hz takes 50..199, else 60.
- Any launcher change needs a restage, validate-staged-library, a purge + GAMESYNC on one box, then every box.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- ioquake3 prints hz:N/A. On the LCDs read DISPLAYCFG get while it is fullscreen; expect 60.
- On .124 the strongest read-back is vcr-kmd's flight recorder. EXEC 'C:\vcr\vcrctl.exe log' redirected to a file, then DOWNLOAD it, as 124-window/runq.py does. Events 300/301 show every mode set with its PLL refresh, probes included.
  - Expect the final 'mode 199: 1280x960x32@75' today, and '1280x960x32@85' (mode 160) after the fix.
  - Also C:\retrogl.log for that pid ('fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85').
- Retail 1.32c: +set logfile 2, then qconsole.log: '...calling CDS: ok', 'MODE: -1, W x H fullscreen hz:N', and no '...trying next higher resolution'.
- The LCD screens belong to the 1080p lane. On .124, one paced launch with the V5 lane's OK.
titles.verifier_notes:
Mostly CONFIRMED by independent re-derivation. What was re-checked:
- md5s of every binary; case-insensitive strings.
- A whole-file (not code-only) 4-byte xref for each r_displayRefresh global.
- The SDL CDS logic at 0x681388be/0x68138dd5/0x68134d40, and the retail read at 0x459ee7.
- GAMERES 03:56 values; deployed launcher md5s; FLEETGL gating; FR_UE1DEV/GlideRender strings in FLEETRES.EXE.
- The HKLM value, the Glide source path and the deployed Glide md5.

Corrections:
(1) .124 ioquake3 at 75 is MEASURED (124-window/run2.txt: DISPLAYCFG plus the flight recorder), not inferred.
(2) lan_check.py does not use the shortcut, so the fix would not move its rows to 85. It would leave them at 75 and out of step with the shortcut; it needs the env line too. It is also a third fleetres.cfg writer.
(3) gr_cfg_body(NULL) is shared with JediAcademy, so any token flip must cover all five launchers.
(4) The mirror test is per-title, not per-launcher.
(5) The retail '75' comes from V56KBENCH.BAT's run, not the retail shortcut.
(6) .240's HWPROFILE is dated 01:07.

Evidence: /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-refresh/review-idtech-q3-ja-sof2-rtcw-d3-r2/ (static-rechecks.txt, 124-ioquake3-measured.txt, writers-and-tests.txt).

titles.refresh_control:
CONFIRMED. Both exes honour r_displayRefresh.
- Registered with flags 0x20 CVAR_LATCH (push 0x20 at jasp 0x469ad7 / jamp 0x4a2349) and CheckRange 0..200. Stored in jasp 0xc98410 / jamp 0xfe311c.
- Whole-file references: jasp 0x469487/0x469aff/0x48b435; jamp 0x4a1fa0/0x4a236f/0x4c5b97.
- GLW_SetMode reads it at jasp 0x48b434 / jamp 0x4c5b96. dmFields goes from 0x180000 to 0x580000 and dmDisplayFrequency is set, then CDS_FULLSCREEN.
- On failure: '...trying next higher resolution:' and the first mode >= the request with bpp>=15, at that entry's own rate.
- The ENUM_CURRENT read at jasp 0x48b3e1 is the TAIL of GLW_SetMode: the fullscreen branch starts at 0x48b40a and rejoins it. So 'MODE: ... hz:N' is read after the context, and after Glide's mode set on .124. jamp's is at 0x4c5e19.
- 'Display refresh set to %d' (jamp 0x557214) prints the CVAR (0x4a1fa0 reads r_displayRefresh->integer), not the actual rate. The MODE line is the measurement.
- .124: the Glide FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 override applies on top. retrogl.log shows 8 jamp opens with '1280x960 max 85 Hz -> enum 7'.

Its value slot 0x7d3a48 is referenced only at:
- 0x4acd5b: R_InitOpenGL copies it into glimpParms.displayHz.
- 0x4acdc7: the safe-mode fallback SetInteger(0).
- 0x4ad82d: the vid_restart path.

GLW_SetFullScreen (0x50b910):
- First it scans EnumDisplaySettings for a 32-bpp mode with w>=, h>= (and freq == displayHz if non-zero). A size match without the rate logs '...%dhz is unsupported at %dx%d' and zeroes the rate. No 32-bpp size match logs '...unsupported in 32 bit' and fails.
- Then dmFields 0x1c0000, or 0x5c0000 only with a non-zero rate, and CDS_FULLSCREEN. On failure, '...trying next higher resolution:'.

glConfig.displayFrequency (0x138b42c) has ONE reference in the whole file, the GfxInfo read at 0x4ac723, so the log always says 'hz:N/A'.

The lever is '+set r_displayRefresh N' on the command line.

titles.fix_risk:
Low. The rate must be listed at the EXACT 32-bpp mode:
- If no mode at least that big carries it, the engine zeroes the rate. Harmless.
- If only a LARGER mode carries it, the CDS fails. The engine then takes the next-higher fallback (another mode and/or rate), and if that also fails it drops to safe mode at 640x480 with the rate reset to 0.
gr_best_hz at FR_W x FR_H avoids all of this.

The interim %FR_HZ% would be wrong only on a box whose target differs from its persisted desktop mode. None today.
